MeshClass.description:
Traffic class, which selects the routing protocol.

Flooding everything is epidemic routing: highest delivery, but buffer exhaustion and battery drain, which is fatal for phones in pockets. See plan/methods.md section 5. The UPLINK recommendation was deliberately revised after measurement: PRoPHET bought only 0.6 percentage points of delivery for about 3.1x the radio traffic, so both loss-tolerant classes now use the bounded policy until encounter predictability proves a material gain.

MeshMessage.description:
Envelope for anything crossing the mesh.

sequence prevents duplicate processing; ttl stops packets travelling forever. Both are enforced at every hop, not just at the destination.
